0022600107.text: Both teams are off to 2-0 starts, with the Atlanta Hawks (1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East) hosting the Houston Rockets (1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) in the Hawks' third game of the season, and Atlanta has yet to play at home this year. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston's Reed Sheppard is day-to-day with a knee bruise and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Hawks lost both games to Houston in 2025-26, including a 117-95 loss in Houston on March 20, 2026.
